name: Audio Kaleidoscope
description: Videotron style kaleidoscope that moves on the beat: built in neon VJ patterns or the layer itself, folded into classic wedges, triangle, square or hex mirror tiles, an endless tunnel or fractal folds. Beat Motion steps the animation on every beat, blooms rings from the center, steps the colors or strobes like an LED wall, synced by BPM or NmTools Audio Keys, with an LED screen look.
